changes.result: Added a focused active-order presentation adapter and HUD order card. It exposes one customer product identity, original product color mark, shelf route, lifecycle status, and shelf-stock context; the empty state remains explicit. Added adapter tests for active and empty order branches.

Extended the existing procedural Phaser beach renderer with layered water/wave and shoreline cues, shells and decorative marks, market awnings, and clearer local merchandising/station hierarchy. Existing spatial coordinates and core harvest/deposit/packing/cash mechanics remain in use; no external or first-version expression was copied.

Added nullable nextMarketId to simulation state and an explicit settlement next-market branch with two original local market choices. Normal selection records the chosen market and returns to operating; restart creates a fresh state and clears the choice. The existing continue-round control remains a valid normal-input path.
